desc: Ideate the solution approach (Segment Tree with lazy propagation and monotonicity exploitation).
Implement the Segment Tree class with `push` for lazy propagation.
Implement `update_range(l, r, val)` to add `val` to all elements in index range $[l, r]$.
Implement `find_first_ge(val)` to find the smallest index $i$ such that $A[i] \ge val$.
Implement `find_last_le(val)` to find the largest index $i$ such that $A[i] \le val$.
Write the main logic: initialize tree with $A[i]=i$, process $N$ contests (query ranges, update), then answer $Q$ queries.
Add fast I/O and handle edge cases (e.g., no valid range found).
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check for potential performance bottlenecks in Python (e.g., recursion depth, I/O speed).
If all tests pass, mark as solved.
